proof: Every heartbeat contains worker_name and the healthcheck rejects a mismatched identity.
Atomic os.replace prevents a concurrent probe from accepting a partially written document.
Missing, malformed, starting, zero-tick, wrong-worker, invalid-timing, and stale heartbeat cases fail closed.
The CLI probe preserved unavailable downstream truth in controller_status and last_failure_reason while proving the loop completed its tick.
No request, receipt, reconciliation result, or downstream correlation contract changed; the heartbeat records the existing controller_status alongside process liveness.
Each worker writes status=starting and ticks=0 before its first network call, invalidating a retained prior green file.
Freshness thresholds make a blocked worker unhealthy after 300 seconds for consumer/listener or 900 seconds for scheduler by default.
Reverting the task commit removes only process-local heartbeat code and the three Compose probes; no data migration or business-state compensation is required.
Existing durable consumer/listener state paths and reconciliation authority are unchanged.
